description: Build the FastAPI backend foundation with SQLite database, ORM models, seeded demo data (public policies, employee handbook, confidential financial records, simulated API credentials), and three simulated tools (read_file, search_records, send_email). All tools must be non-functional stubs that store actions in the database. Database schema: security_events, threats, activity_logs, policies, pending_approvals, simulated_files (with security classification), simulated_records, email_outbox. Backend must run on port 8000 with CORS enabled.
steps: Create backend/ directory with subdirectories: agent/, security/, tools/, routes/, models/, database/, tests/
Create backend/requirements.txt with FastAPI, uvicorn, SQLAlchemy, pydantic, python-dotenv, google-generativeai, pytest dependencies
Create backend/main.py with FastAPI app, CORS setup, health check endpoint (/health), and import of all route handlers

Create backend/database/models.py with SQLAlchemy ORM classes: SecurityEvent, Threat, ActivityLog, Policy, PendingApproval, SimulatedFile (with classification enum: PUBLIC/INTERNAL/RESTRICTED), SimulatedRecord, EmailOutbox
Create backend/database/database.py with SQLAlchemy engine and session factory for SQLite (agentshield.db)

Create backend/database/seed.py with function to seed demo data: 3 policies (employee/manager/admin roles with different tool permissions), 5 simulated files (public handbook, internal reports, restricted financial records containing API key placeholders), 10 simulated records (employee data), system initialization check to avoid re-seeding
Create backend/models/ directory with Pydantic schemas: RequestSchema, ToolCallRequest, SecurityEventSchema, ThreatSchema, PolicySchema, ApprovalSchema
Create backend/tools/file_tool.py with read_file function stub (validates filename against allowlist, returns file content from SimulatedFile, records activity)
Create backend/tools/database_tool.py with search_records function stub (searches SimulatedRecord by query, returns results, records activity)
Create backend/tools/email_tool.py with send_email function stub (stores to EmailOutbox, records activity, never sends real email)
Create backend/routes/events.py with GET /api/events (list SecurityEvents with filtering), POST /api/events (record new event)
Create backend/routes/policies.py with GET /api/policies, GET /api/policies/{id}, PUT /api/policies/{id} (with validation)

Verify: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (create minimal test file), verify backend starts with uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000, check SQLite database is created with tables, verify seeded data loads
acceptance_criteria: Backend starts on http://localhost:8000 with no errors
SQLite database (agentshield.db) is created with correct schema
Seeded demo data is loaded on first run (policies, files, records)
All four tool stub functions exist and record activities
CORS is enabled for frontend origin (localhost:5173)
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests pass
uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 — server starts without error
curl http://localhost:8000/api/policies — returns list of policies
Verify agentshield.db file exists and contains expected tables via sqlite3 CLI
